data.title: General, crystallized and fluid intelligence are not associated with functional global network efficiency: A replication study with the human connectome project 1200 data set
data.text:
We defined networks (8 network schemes) based on voxel-wise data at 4 mm isotropic resolution containing all voxels (21637 voxels), voxel-wise data at 4 mm isotropic resolution containing only grey matter voxels (16 071 voxels), automated anatomical labeling (116 regions), the atlas by Power et al. (2011) (264 regions), and the atlas by Craddock et al. (2012) (840 regions).

Group-ICA data was provided by the HCP, and subject-specific time series were derived using dual regression. Connectivity matrices were derived using the FSLNets toolbox, either via full correlation or partial correlation with L2-regularization with a regularization parameter of 0.01.

These networks were thresholded using a proportional threshold in the range of 0.1–0.5 in steps of 0.01.

For each of these networks we computed the following graph measures: global efficiency and characteristic path length. For exploratory purposes, we also computed the global clustering coefficient.
